spans.s:
m. (-वः)
1 Sacrifice, oblation.
2 Call, calling.
3 Order, command.
4 Challenging, defying.
E.
हु to sacrifice, or ह्वे to call, अप् aff.

हवा or हवाव
ind.
A term implying undoubtedly, certainly: see हि.

m. (-वः)
1 Any feminine act of amorous pastime, or tending to excite amorous sensations, coquetry, blandishment, dalliance.
2 Calling.
E.
ह्वेञ् to call, (to incite passion,) घञ् aff.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Eating rice and curds from a cup of bell-metal.
E.
हव sacrifice, गम to go, aff. खश्.

m. (-नः)
Sacrifice, offering, oblation.
f. (-नी)
A hole in the ground for receiving a sacrificial fire.
E.
हु to sacrifice, ल्युट्. or युच् aff.

m. (-युः)
Fire.
E.
हवन burnt-offering, and आयुस् life.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be offered with fire, fit for an oblation, &c.
n. (-यं)
Ghee.
E.
हु to sacrifice, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-षः)
The residue of an oblation of Ghee or clarified butter.
E.
हविस्, and शेष rest.

f. (-त्री)
A hole in the ground for containing a sacrificial fire.
E.
हु to sacrifice, इत्रन् aff.

m. (-नः)
Fire.
E.
हविस् Ghee, अशन food.

n. (-हं)
A room in which a burnt-offering is made, a place of sacrifice.
E.
हविस् Ghee, and गेह a house or apartment.

m. (-भुक्)
Fire.
E.
हविस्, and भुज् who eats.

m. (-जी)
A priest.
E.
हविस्, and याजिन् who offers.

n. (-ष्यं)
1 Clarified butter.
2 Rice mixed with Ghee.
E.
हविस् an oblation, यत् aff. of fitness.

m. (-भुक्)
Fire.
E.
हविष्य, and भुज् who eats; also हविष्याशिन्, &c.

n. (-विः)
1 Clarified butter.
2 An intended oblation, the article to be so offered, usually clarified butter.
3 Water.
E.
हु to offer in oblation, असि Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Fit or proper to be offered in oblation.
n. (-व्यं)
1 An offering to the gods.
2 Ghee.
E.
हु to sacrifice, यत् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 An oblation dressed for the deities.
2 The vessel in which it is prepared.
E.
हव्य an offering to the gods, and पाक cooking.

m. (-हः)
Fire.
E.
हव्य an oblation, and वाह who bears.

m. (-नः)
Fire.
E.
हव्य an oblation, and वाहन vehicle.

m. (-शः)
Fire.
E.
हव्य an oblation, and अश who eats.

m. (-नः)
AGNI or fire.
E.
हव्य a burnt offering, and अशन food.
